demo.title: starchild-dao.sh
demo.code:
# See what's on the table
bankr prompt "using the starchild-dao skill, show me the proposals"

# Stake to get a voice (never burned, withdraw anytime)
bankr prompt "using the starchild-dao skill, stake 5,000,000 STARCHILD"

# Back a proposal — gasless signature, no fee
bankr prompt "using the starchild-dao skill, vote for the mobile app proposal"

# Put a new idea forward (needs 10M staked)
bankr prompt "using the starchild-dao skill, propose: fund a contributor bounty pool, paid from fees, never touching the app"

setup: Hold and stake $STARCHILD on Base to vote; 10,000,000 staked to propose
Votes and proposals are gasless EIP-712 signatures — no transaction fees
The app stays private, local & free — proposals must never gate or compromise it
